create.name: Dee Wallace
create.bio:
Dee Wallace is an American actress and teacher of what she calls conscious creation: the idea that each person shapes their own life by where they direct energy, attention and love, beginning with love for oneself. Best known on screen for E.T. and Cujo, she turned towards spiritual work after her husband died suddenly, when, she says, she received an inner message to use the light within to heal herself. Since then she has worked as a channel, presenting teachings she receives from what she simply calls the channel, and has written several books on self-creation, among them Conscious Creation, Bright Light and BORN, as well as picture books on self-love for children.

Her teaching is practical and conversational. Every Sunday morning she hosts a live call-in show, Conscious Creation, now past eight hundred episodes, where listeners bring questions about money, relationships, faith or purpose and she works through the beliefs behind them. She also runs monthly webinars on single themes such as faith, possibility and the trade-offs people believe they must make, sells recorded exercises for directing the day, and offers short private sessions by phone or in person from her home in Woodland Hills, in the Los Angeles area, focused on spotting limiting beliefs and fears and bringing life back into balance.

courses.title: Private Healing Session with Dee
courses.description: A one-to-one session by phone or in person, aimed at noticing the beliefs and fears that hold you back and restoring a sense of balance. Booked through her online calendar.

courses.title: 4 Cornerstones of Creation
courses.description: Six videos setting out her framework for designing and sustaining the life you want to create. A download to watch at home.

courses.title: Accessing Your Wisdom Potential
courses.description: A bundle of recorded webinars on choice, channelling, empowerment and the energy of the universe, with an individual channelled reading on what most blocks your access to wisdom.

courses.title: FAITH – Webinar from Dee Wallace
courses.description: A recorded webinar in which she and the channel look at faith as a set of working principles, starting from feeling safe in your own power.

courses.title: THE TRADE OFF – Webinar with Dee Wallace
courses.description: A webinar on the belief that getting one thing means giving up another, such as energy for money, and how to bring that belief into balance.

courses.title: ALL POSSIBILITIES: How to Create Them, Allow Them, and Manifest Them in Every Area of Our Lives
courses.description: A recorded webinar about widening what you allow yourself to imagine, so that creation is not narrowed from the start.

courses.title: Exercises for Directing Your Day
courses.description: Two guided exercises as a download, starting from a 'love place' and then setting intentions for the day ahead.

free_resources.title: ASK AND YOU RECEIVE
free_resources.description: A recorded webinar, currently free in her shop, on how to ask clearly for what you want, beginning with an open heart.
